profile.name: Triga Core Graphics Profile v0
refinements: lit row narrowed to MeshPhongMaterial only (PBR MeshStandardMaterial stays unsupported)
lighting narrowed to ambient + directional only (PointLight stays unsupported)

proof_requirements.requirement: Camera projection probas: non-null projection/view for valid fov/aspect/near/far and eye/target/up; degenerate negatives; facts float_count/scale terms match Matrix4 elements; declared-target equivalence at the highest executed tier

Camera facts consumed by the admitted render descriptor: projection terms feed the host transform/view binding; view-projection numeric sample in the headless-browser draw matches the Triga-computed matrix
Exact-value probas for positions/normals/UVs/winding/indices; negative validation (wrong attribute counts, malformed ranges, unknown topology); target-equivalence for the generated attributes
Indexed geometry consumed by the admitted descriptor: one drawIndexed per mesh with the position/normal/UV vertex-input layout; pixel/numeric sample verifies the drawn triangles

supported.name: Model/view-projection transforms
supported.state_today: 32 f32 / 128 bytes vs hosts reflection 64 f32 / 256 bytes — drift

proof_requirements.requirement: Value probas for matrix4_* composition and TransformPayload (float_count/byte_count/model_value/view_projection_value); non-finite input cannot hang; target-equivalence at the highest executed tier
One versioned schema resolves the 32/128 vs 64/256 transform disagreement and generates/validates every Triga/Radix/Hosts reader; per-frame transform buffer numeric sample in the admitted draw
Typed validation of the pipeline/material facts and profile semantics stating which facts affect culling, depth, and opacity/alpha; composition tests against the profile material/light rows
The admitted pipeline's depth_stencil (depth compare + write) matches the Triga facts — no host default silently substitutes; pixel sample verifies depth occlusion/culling in the drawn scene

Typed construction + validation negatives for MeshPhongMaterial (color/specular/shininess); composition with the Mesh renderable's material union; probe that PBR MeshStandardMaterial stays outside the profile
Lit row rendered through the admitted pipeline; deterministic pixel sample proves Phong shading occurs (not flat/no-lighting)

Typed construction + validation of the two light contracts (color/intensity; DirectionalLight.target_position); composition tests in a profile scene; probe that entities not in the profile (PointLight) reject or are excluded at composition
Ambient + directional light facts consumed by the admitted descriptor/bindings; pixel/numeric sample verifies the lighting law (ambient term + directional contribution)

hosts_owned_in_profile.name: Resize and device-loss
hosts_owned_in_profile.state_today: no Triga surface; hosts no-draw placeholder state (engine.js triga-lit.* placeholders rejected at admission)

proof_requirements.requirement: Headless-browser draw survives resize (depth/texture resize path) and device-loss rejection/recovery uses published facts or rejects explicitly

unsupported.name: PBR MeshStandardMaterial
unsupported.reason: Carrier-only; no render path; broad horizon; lit row is narrowed to MeshPhongMaterial

unsupported.name: PointLight
unsupported.reason: Carrier-only; not consumed by the retained lighting row (ambient + directional only)

unsupported.name: Textures
unsupported.reason: Placeholder seed only; no sampler/mipmap/render-target pipeline in the profile

unsupported.name: Animation/skinning
unsupported.reason: No live module; renderable/skin and renderable/morph are planned, not present

unsupported.name: Shadows
unsupported.reason: No live module; lighting/shadow is planned, not present

unsupported.name: Post-processing
unsupported.reason: No live module; multipass/render-target surface is absent

unsupported.name: Instancing
unsupported.reason: Batch facts carry an instance_count field only; no instanced-draw surface; renderable/instance planned

unsupported.name: Terrain/voxel
unsupported.reason: FaceQuad voxel face-code helpers are shape-only and not part of the admitted draw proof; primitives/terrain and primitives/voxel planned

unsupported.name: Asset ingestion
unsupported.reason: ResourceHandle is pure generation identity; no glTF/GLB ingestion module

size_assumptions.purpose: assumptions for the bounded Stage 7 draw proof — not the Stage 8 stress budget
assumptions: at most one lit mesh carrying MeshPhongMaterial

capabilities_ledger.note: proof/capabilities.json (ledger_revision 1) rows remain unsupported; only Core Graphics Profile v0 is eligible for upgrade, at Stage 8
